tool.name: 3DTrees: SmartTile
tool.description: Tile, merge and remap point clouds

param.label: Chunk size (points)
param.help: Maximum number of points read per processing chunk. Lower values reduce peak memory but increase overhead.

param.label: Resolution 1 (m)
param.help: Fine subsampling resolution used by the tile task. It also sets the 3D voxel-diagonal matching radius (17.32 mm for 1 cm).

param.label: Prod-merged resolution (m)
param.help: Target spacing for prod-merged outputs in meters.

param.label: Prod-merged formats
param.help: Select one or more output encodings for prod-merged products.

param.name: input_files
param.label: Input LAZ/LAS files
param.help: One or more source point clouds to tile and subsample.

param.label: Tile length (m)
param.help: Target tile edge length in meters.

param.label: Tile buffer (m)
param.help: Overlap added around each tile in meters. The tile grid always starts at the south-west corner of the data extent.

param.label: Tiling threshold (MB)
param.help: Skip tiling for a single input below this size and still create normalized subsampled outputs.

param.label: Resolution 1 (m)
param.help: Fine subsampling resolution in meters.

param.label: Resolution 2 (m)
param.help: Coarse subsampling resolution in meters.

param.label: Subsampling method
param.help: Point representative used when reducing each voxel.

param.label: Write resolution 1 as COPC LAZ
param.help: Return the fine-resolution subsampled collection as COPC LAZ.

param.label: Write resolution 2 as COPC LAZ
param.help: Return the coarse-resolution subsampled collection as COPC LAZ.

param.name: input_segmented
param.label: Primary segmented files
param.help: Segmented prediction files at the same tile layout as the target-resolution subsampled files.

param.name: input_res1
param.label: Target-resolution subsampled files
param.help: Subsampled target files used as the merge geometry reference.

param.name: input_original_laz
param.label: Original LAZ/LAS files
param.help: Original uploaded files to enrich with predictions and use for prod-merged outputs.

param.name: tile_bounds_json
param.label: Tile bounds JSON
param.help: Tile bounds JSON emitted by the tile task for the same tiling run.

param.label: Instance dimension
param.help: Name of the prediction instance dimension in segmented inputs, for example PredInstance_SAT, PredInstance_FM or PredInstance_RCT.

validator.message: Use letters, numbers, and underscores only; start with a letter or underscore.

param.label: Ownership anchor
param.help: Point of each instance whose XY position decides which tile core owns it; the centroid is the XY centroid.

param.name: mode
param.label: RayCloudTools tree tables
param.help: Supply the tree tables for RayCloudTools predictions (instance dimension PredInstance_RCT).

param.name: enabled
param.label: Cross-tile instance reconciliation
param.help: Give retained instances that continue across a tile boundary one shared ID.

param.label: Overlap threshold
param.help: Minimum shared-point ratio for reconciling instances across tiles.

param.name: enabled
param.label: Small cluster reassignment
param.help: After deduplication, give small instances the ID of the remaining instance with the nearest XY centroid (horizontal distance, within 5 m). Not available for RayCloudTools.

param.label: Max bounding-box volume (m3)
param.help: Instances below this axis-aligned bounding-box volume are small.

param.label: Max cluster size (points)
param.help: Only instances with fewer points on the 1 cm tiles are checked against the volume limit.

param.name: input_tree_files
param.label: Tree tables from 3dtrees_raycloudtools
param.help: Both the *_trees.txt and *_trees_info.txt table for every segmented tile.

param.name: input_tree_meshes
param.label: QSM tree meshes from 3dtrees_raycloudtools
param.help: Optional: the *_trees_mesh.ply of every segmented tile (RayCloudTools 1.3.0 or newer, with per-face tree IDs). Filtered with the same IDs as the tiles and tables.

param.name: merged_file
param.label: Merged LAZ/COPC LAZ file
param.help: Single merged prediction file whose extra dimensions should be transferred to originals.

param.name: merged_file_is_copc
param.label: Merged file is COPC LAZ
param.help: Preserve the .copc.laz suffix for tools that infer COPC status from the file name.

param.name: collection
param.label: Segmented files collection
param.help: Filtered/merged target-resolution tiles of one model, as produced by the merge task (optionally after DetailView).

param.name: tree_files
param.label: RayCloudTools tree tables
param.help: For a PredInstance_RCT collection only: the filtered tree tables emitted by the merge task.

param.name: tree_meshes
param.label: RayCloudTools QSM tree meshes
param.help: For a PredInstance_RCT collection only, optional: the filtered tree meshes emitted by the merge task.

param.label: Dimension allowlist
param.help: Comma-separated extra dimensions to transfer; empty transfers all extra dimensions.

validator.message: Use comma-separated dimension names containing only letters, numbers, and underscores.

param.name: original_files
param.label: Original LAZ/LAS files
param.help: Original uploaded files to enrich with remapped prediction dimensions.

param.name: baseline_res1
param.label: Resolution-1 tiles
param.help: The resolution-1 subsampled collection from the tile task of the same run. Every original point must lie within the matching radius of this geometry.

param.name: original_with_predictions
param.label: Original-with-predictions files
param.help: Original files that already contain prediction dimensions.

param.label: Output formats
param.help: Select one or more output encodings for prod-merged products.

collection.name: output_remap_tree_meshes
collection.label: ${tool.name}: RayCloudTools QSM tree meshes per original

collection.name: prod_merged_outputs
collection.label: ${tool.name}: Prod-merged LAZ/COPC products
collection.filter: (operation['task'] == "create_merged_file" and ("laz" in operation['merged_output_formats'] or "copc.laz" in operation['merged_output_formats'])) or (operation['task'] == "remap" and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == "True" and ("laz" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'] or "copc.laz" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'])) or (operation['task'] == "merge" and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == "True" and operation['input_original_laz'] and ("laz" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'] or "copc.laz" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats']))

collection.name: prod_merged_ply_outputs
collection.label: ${tool.name}: Prod-merged PLY products
collection.filter: (operation['task'] == "create_merged_file" and "ply" in operation['merged_output_formats']) or (operation['task'] == "remap" and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == "True" and "ply" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats']) or (operation['task'] == "merge" and operation['prod_merged']['create'] == "True" and operation['input_original_laz'] and "ply" in operation['prod_merged']['merged_output_formats'])

tool.help:
SmartTile prepares and post-processes point-cloud predictions for the 3Dtrees workflow. Select one task according to the stage of processing you want to run.
**Tile and subsample**
Splits one or more LAZ/LAS point clouds into buffered spatial tiles and writes two subsampled collections. The tile task also writes a tiling preview image and a tile bounds JSON file. Use the tile bounds JSON with the merge task so SmartTile can identify tile cores and buffers consistently.
All inputs must share one projected CRS in metres (for example UTM), or carry no CRS (local metres). Tile length, buffer and resolutions are metres, so the tile task stops with a CRS error for geographic (degree, e.g. EPSG:4326), geocentric (e.g. EPSG:4978) or foot-based CRSs and for inputs with different CRSs. Reproject such data before upload.
**Filter/Merge segmented tiles**
Transfers each tile's predictions onto its resolution-1 geometry, then removes whole instances whose ownership anchor lies outside the tile core toward a neighboring tile. Remaining overlap duplicates are removed only when a surviving point with agreeing labels lies within 1 cm. Provide the segmented prediction files, the resolution-1 subsampled files, and the tile bounds JSON from the same tiling run. The job's working directory keeps a merge report of every ownership, recovery and deduplication decision as local evidence; it is not a Galaxy output. The `INSTANCE_DIMENSION_summary.json` output (for example `PredInstance_SAT_summary.json`) lists every final instance with its point count, bounding box, bounding-box volume, centroid (source CRS) and any IDs reassigned into it.
For RayCloudTools predictions (`PredInstance_RCT`), supply both tree tables per tile. SmartTile keeps whole trees, never moves points between trees and does not reconcile IDs across tiles. Retained IDs are written as `tile_id * 100000 + local_id` in the tiles and in both filtered tables; small-cluster reassignment is not available for them.
Optional small-cluster reassignment runs after deduplication on the final 1 cm tiles: an instance with fewer than the maximum cluster size (default 3,000 points) and a bounding box below the maximum volume (default 4 m³) takes the ID of the remaining instance with the nearest XY centroid (horizontal distance, height ignored) within 5 m. Only instance IDs change; the summary JSON lists `reassigned_from` per instance.
When original LAZ/LAS files are provided, the merge task can also transfer predictions back to the originals and create prod-merged products.
**Remap predictions to originals**
Transfers prediction dimensions from either one merged prediction file or one or more segmented prediction collections back onto the original uploaded LAZ/LAS files. The resolution-1 tiles from the tile task are required. Every original point must lie within the matching radius of that geometry, and every non-RCT model must cover 100% of the original points. RCT points without a surviving tree within the radius become background `0`; the coverage report in the job's working directory counts them (local evidence, not a Galaxy output).
RCT tree IDs are compacted once across the dataset to `1..N`. Each original `NAME.laz` gets matching `NAME_trees.txt` and `NAME_trees_info.txt` tables. Add the filtered tree tables from the merge task to the RCT prediction collection.
Optional QSM tree meshes (RayCloudTools 1.3.0+ `*_trees_mesh.ply`, per-face `tree_id`) follow the same IDs: merge keeps only the faces of retained trees with tile-prefixed IDs; remap writes `NAME_trees_mesh.ply` per original with the complete retained model of exactly the trees in its tables and the final compact IDs. Supply a mesh for every tile or none. Terrain meshes are not processed. Use the dimension allowlist only when you want to copy a selected set of prediction dimensions from segmented collections.
**Create prod-merged file**
Creates delivery-ready products from original-with-prediction files that already contain prediction dimensions. Prod-merged outputs can be LAZ, COPC LAZ, or binary PLY. COPC LAZ is selected with the format value `copc.laz` and is returned to Galaxy as `laz`; PLY is returned as `plybinary`.
